title: Specialty Chemical Drums Supply and Offtake Master Agreement
description: Supply contract specifying volume commitments both in words ('five thousand units') and as a production range ('between 4.000 and 6.000 drums').

payment_terms.quote: Buyer shall pay all validated invoices under payment terms of Net 60 days from shipping date.

price_adjustment.quote: Unit prices are subject to an index-linked adjustment pegged to the European Chemical Producer Price Index annually.

contract_term.quote: This Agreement shall endure for an initial duration of 36 months starting October 1, 2024.

auto_renewal.quote: The Agreement shall automatically renew for successive 12-month periods unless either party gives written notice.

termination_notice.quote: Either party may terminate upon providing written notice of at least 60 days.

liability_cap.quote: The total cumulative liability of Manufacturer shall not exceed 1,200,000 EUR for all defect claims.

governing_law.quote: This Agreement is governed in its entirety by the substantive laws of Germany.

volume_commitment.raw: five thousand units (between 4.000 and 6.000 drums per quarter)
volume_commitment.quote: Buyer hereby covenants to an annual baseline volume commitment written as five thousand units of certified composite chemical drums.
